deals.whyRanked: Allegiant one-way from $60 (Feb 7), about $120–160 round trip, down from $122 yesterday; Everglades and Biscayne NPs within ~1 h.
deals.soloWhy: Compact beach and Las Olas districts, Brightline and Tri-Rail for car-free day trips to Miami.

highlights: Fort Lauderdale Beach promenade at A1A
Las Olas Boulevard shops and riverwalk
Shark Valley tram and bike loop in Everglades NP
itinerary: Day 1 — Beach, A1A walk, sunset on Las Olas
Day 2 — Everglades Shark Valley bike loop (15 mi), airboat optional
Day 3 — Water taxi to Hollywood or Brightline to Miami's Wynwood, then depart
guide.gettingAround: Rental car helps for the Everglades; otherwise Sun Trolley, water taxi and Brightline cover the coast.
guide.stayArea: Las Olas or Victoria Park for walkability and beach access via trolley.

deals.whyRanked: Allegiant one-way from $64 (Dec 13), about $128–175 round trip, down from $146; Great Smoky Mountains NP ~45 min away.
deals.soloWhy: Walkable Market Square and Old City, free downtown trolley, easy Smokies day trip.

highlights: Cades Cove loop in the Smokies
Alum Cave Trail to Mt. LeConte (winter ice check)
itinerary: Day 1 — Market Square, Old City, Sunsphere at dusk
Day 2 — Smokies via Gatlinburg entrance; Alum Cave Trail or Cades Cove
Day 3 — Ijams Nature Center and Knoxville Greenway, then depart
guide.gettingAround: Rental car needed for the Smokies; downtown has a free trolley.
guide.stayArea: Downtown or Old City for walkable food and nightlife.

deals.whyRanked: Allegiant one-way $73 (Dec 11), about $146–190 round trip, down from $160; boosted for Blue Ridge Parkway 15 min away and top solo-trip fit.
deals.soloWhy: Walkable downtown, hostels, social brewery scene and trailheads minutes away.

highlights: Blue Ridge Parkway overlooks (check winter closures)
Brewery row on Biltmore Ave and South Slope
itinerary: Day 1 — Downtown, Pack Square, River Arts District murals
Day 2 — Parkway drive to Craggy Pinnacle, then Folk Art Center
Day 3 — Biltmore Estate or Max Patch if the road is open, then depart
guide.gettingAround: Rental car for Parkway and trailheads; downtown is walkable. Parkway sections close in ice.
guide.stayArea: Downtown or the South Slope for walkability and breweries.

deals.whyRanked: Allegiant one-way $70 (Jan 25), about $140–185 round trip, up from $124; Siesta Key and Myakka River State Park nearby.
deals.soloWhy: Safe, walkable downtown and Main Street, with beaches a short drive or bus ride away.

highlights: Myakka canopy walkway and airboat tour
itinerary: Day 1 — Downtown, Marina Jack, sunset on Lido Key
Day 2 — Myakka River State Park, then Siesta Key
Day 3 — Ringling Museum and Ca' d'Zan, then depart
guide.gettingAround: Car recommended; SCAT buses reach the beaches but run infrequently.

deals.whyRanked: Allegiant one-way $89 (Nov 20), about $178–225 round trip, an inexpensive short-notice option; solo-friendly and walkable.
deals.soloWhy: Compact skywalk-linked downtown with a trail network and a strong farmers market.

itinerary: Day 1 — Sculpture Park, Capitol tour, East Village
Day 2 — Art Center and Gray's Lake loop
Day 3 — Brunch in the Western Gateway, then depart
guide.gettingAround: Downtown is walkable; use rideshare or a short car rental for Gray's Lake.
guide.stayArea: East Village or downtown near the Principal Riverwalk.
